PostpartumRecovery.6: Ugris-ik yesra lweqt: acu i d amagnu seld ma tulaḍ.
PostpartumRecovery.9: Ussan imezwura: ad tensiḍ u ad d-tuɣaleḍ
PostpartumRecovery.10: Acu i izmer ad yili d amagnu deg uɣal
PostpartumRecovery.12: Iseḥḥen u tuɣalin n yimala s wudem aqrawan
PostpartumRecovery.19: Ussan imezwura: ad tensiḍ u ad d-tuɣaleḍ
PostpartumRecovery.20: Acu i izmer ad yili d amagnu deg uɣal
PostpartumRecovery.22: Iseḥḥen u tuɣalin n yimala s wudem aqrawan
PostpartumRecovery.28: Lweqt seld tulawt yeḍfer tulawt. Ur yeqqim ara kra n wussan kan: ugris, ukud n yal ass d iwulmen zemren ad ttkemmilen ad ttbeddilen s wudem aqrawan deg yimalas i d-yeḍfaren.
PostpartumRecovery.29: “Lquṛantin” d tikkelt yettwasnen i d-yettwaseqdacen akken ad d-ttwabder yimalas imezwura n uɣal. Tezmer ad tili d ammud yelhan: seld lḥemla d tulawt, yelha ad tensiḍ u ad tefkeḍ lweqt i ugris.
PostpartumRecovery.31: Uɣal yeqqen ɣer ugris, maca daɣen ɣer unẓar, tazmert, ussuter n yal ass d usmil n wul ɣer uzray amaynut n tudert.
PostpartumRecovery.32: Ussan imezwura zemren ad ilin weɛṛen. Iseḥḥen, aɣbel amatu d usemmel ɣer ukud amaynut d ayen i d-yettilin d tazwart. Ulac ilaq ad d-tuɣaleḍ ɣer tazmert-ik n yal ass sya ɣer dayen.
PostpartumRecovery.34: Asnawen gar leqdic d uḥeṭṭel yettɛawan ugris ad d-yuɣal s wudem aqrawan.
PostpartumRecovery.36: Ad tečč s lemɛawda u ad tessuḍ akken i k-yehwa tettɛawan deg uɣal n yal ass.
PostpartumRecovery.38: Aqbal n tallalt yeǧǧa ad tḥerzeḍ tazmert i uɣbel ilaqen u i uɣal.
PostpartumRecovery.40: Uɣal s wudem aqrawan ɣer tikli d yimala, s uklal n waddad-ik d lḥal-ik.
PostpartumRecovery.41: Yal uɣal yemxalaf. Kra n yisnifilen zemren ad ilin d aḥric n lweqt n usemmel u ad ttbeddilen s wudem aqrawan:
PostpartumRecovery.43: Aḥraf n idammen i yettnaqqasen s wudem aqrawan
PostpartumRecovery.44: Isnifilen n yihurmunen d wid n wul
PostpartumRecovery.45: Azal d wakud n tilɣa zemren ad ttemxalafen seg yiwen ɣer wayeḍ. Ayen yelhan d ad tɛassed amek ttbeddilent u ad tsuteḍ talwit ma yella yiwen n usnifel yettban d ayen i k-yettaɣen neɣ ur nelli ara d amagnu.
PostpartumRecovery.46: Deg wakud seld tulawt, iɣbalen imecṭuḥen, imesbaɣen, s waṭas llan d ayen yelhan akteṛ n uɣbel yewɛer. Iswi d ad tɛawneḍ uɣal war ma tezdiḍ aṭṭaf.
PostpartumRecovery.47: Ɣer deg wanda ilaq, sbedd iwaliwen n tuɣalin n tideț.
PostpartumRecovery.48: Suter tallalt i yimsalen n yal ass d tuččit.
PostpartumRecovery.49: Sew s lemɛawda u ečč tuččit yemxalfen.
PostpartumRecovery.50: Ur tserreḥ ara uɣal-ik i win n wayeḍ.
PostpartumRecovery.51: Uɣal n yimala s wudem aqrawan, war ma tebɣiḍ ad txedmeḍ kullec yakan.
PostpartumRecovery.53: Ad tesɛuḍ tallalt u ad tqebleḍ tallalt mačči d ayen n lǧah. Tezmer ad tḥerz tazmert u ad tawi uɣal s wudem aqrawan.
PostpartumRecovery.54: Uɣal n yimala izmer ad yeḍru tikkelt-tikkelt, s ssebba n lehna, n tazmert d iwellihen i d-yettwafken seld tulawt. Iseḥḥen ahlawan d yimala n yal ass ttwaḥsaben yakan d tuɣalin ɣer uzeṭṭa.
PostpartumRecovery.55: I yimala iweɛren, ayen yelhan d ad tqeddmeḍ war ma tkerfeḍ tifarisin u ad tettwafkeḍ tilɣa neɣ ugur n lehna deg uḥsab.
PostpartumRecovery.57: Ugur i d-yettaggaden deg wakud n unamek yellan d ssebba ad tensiḍ u, ma yella lazem, ad tsuteḍ tallalt i yelhan send ad tkemmleḍ neɣ ad tsnernudeḍ azal.
PostpartumRecovery.58: Anẓar izmer ad yuɣal ur nelli ara d amagnu seld ma tulaḍ. Leɛyaṭ i d-yettwagran izmer ad yesâddi ɣef tazmert, aɛebbi d ayen n wul. Ma yezmer, ad tessefsiḍ kra n yimsalen u ad tebḍuḍ tuɣdit yezmer ad yelhu.
PostpartumRecovery.62: Uɣal s wudem aqrawan d tazwara n tmudmin timaynutin.
PostpartumRecovery.64: Wali amek i teffeɣ tuɣalin u tmeslayeḍ ɣef tuɣalin n yimala s wudem aqrawan.
PostpartumRecovery.65: Lweqt seld tulawt izmer ad d-yawi aṭas n yiwulmen: lfeṛḥ, ccwal, leɛyaṭ, tuɣdit neɣ uḥulfu n usemmil. Iḥulfawen-a zemren ad bddlen s tazzla, nezzeh deg lweqt anda anẓar d tmudmin n yal ass ttbeddilent.
PostpartumRecovery.66: Amsawal d win i tettamnaḍ neɣ d umaẓrag zemren ad ɛawnen mi ara ttuɣalent iwulmen d tigejdanin neɣ mi ara ṭṭfent amḍiq ameqqran deg tudert n yal ass.
PostpartumRecovery.67: Asuter n tallalt d ayen amagnu
PostpartumRecovery.68: Ulac ilaq ad tuɣaleḍ ar teɛyiḍ yakan neɣ ad tettwafḥeḍ akken ad tmeslayeḍ ɣef ayen i tḥessed u ad tsuteḍ tallalt.
PostpartumRecovery.69: Kra n yiḥulfawen yelha ad ttwamsawalent d umaẓrag n ṣṣeḥḥa, nezzeh mi ara ttuɣalent d tiyir, mi ara ttkemmilent neɣ mi ara d-ttawint ccwal ameqqran.
PostpartumRecovery.71: Lweǧɛ neɣ ugur i d-yettuɣalen d ameqqran deg wadeg ma ad yelhu, yessefk ad yettwafk rray n umaẓrag.
PostpartumRecovery.72: Idammen ur nelli ara d ayen n yal ass
PostpartumRecovery.73: Idammen i d-yettuɣalen d imeqqranen s wudem uzɣel neɣ ur nelli ara d ayen n yal ass ilaq ad ttwarawen i umaẓrag n ṣṣeḥḥa.
PostpartumRecovery.75: Ma yella ccwal n wul yettaɣ amḍiq ameqqran neɣ yeǧǧa tudert n yal ass tewɛer, d ayen yelhan ad temmeslayeḍ ɣef waya u ad tsuteḍ tallalt.
PostpartumRecovery.77: Ma yella tcukkeḍ deg uɣal-ik, asuter n rray yettɛawan ad tawiḍ iwellihen i d-yelhan i waddad-ik.
PostpartumRecovery.78: Imedyaten n unadi d tikkelt ibedden ad temmeslayeḍ ɣef uɣal, ɣef tilɣa, ɣef tuɣalin n yimala d isteqsiyen-nniḍen i d-yeqqimen. Asewjed n kra n yisteqsiyen send ad yelhu ad yettɛawan ad ur tettuḍeḍ ara.
PostpartumRecovery.80: Uɣal-iw yetteddu akken ilaq i waddad-iw?
PostpartumRecovery.81: Acu n yimala i izmer ad d-uɣaleɣ s wudem aqrawan?
PostpartumRecovery.82: Acu n tilɣa ilaqen ad ɛassaɣ?
PostpartumRecovery.83: Melmi i izmer ad d-uɣaleɣ ɣer tgensa tuqwiyt ugar?
PostpartumRecovery.84: Ilaq-iyi kra n rray uslig neɣ n tuɣalin?
PostpartumRecovery.85: Uɣal seld tulawt yetteddu s wudem aqrawan u yemxalaf i yal yiwet.
PostpartumRecovery.86: Tinsa d tallalt zemrent ad ilint d aḥric n uɣal.
PostpartumRecovery.87: Isnifilen n ugris, anẓar d iwulmen zemren ad bddlen deg yimalas.
PostpartumRecovery.88: Uɣal n yimala s wudem aqrawan yettɛawan ad tḥerzeḍ tazmert d lehna-inek.
PostpartumRecovery.89: Ma tẓreḍ tilɣa ur nelli ara d tamagnut, tkemmil neɣ i k-yettaɣen, asuter n rray d aɣil yelhan.
PostpartumRecovery.91: Uɣal mačči d tazzla. Ad tkemmleḍ s wudem aqrawan, s uklal n ayen i tḥewweǧeḍ u s usuter n tallalt mi ara yili lazem d ayen ameqqran yakan.
PostpartumRecovery.92: Amagrad-a yella i lǧerr n talɣut kan u ur d-yettnaqqes ara talwit n uṭṭbib i yiman-ik. Ma tḥessed tilɣa tameqqrant, ittkemmilen neɣ i k-yettaɣen, nermes amaẓrag n ṣṣeḥḥa.

PrayerDuringMenstruation.6: Acuɣer taẓallit tbedd deg wakud-a, u amek ara tettidireḍ lweqt-a s lehna.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.8: Agbur-a d asnaw kan. Isteqsiyen n ddin ilaqen ad ttwaseknen i yineɣman yettwasnen. AWA ur d-yettaf ara fatwas neɣ ahilen n ddin usligen.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.11: Ur tettuɣalt ara taẓallit i yekkaten, ur am tuẓumt
PrayerDuringMenstruation.14: Deg tiregwa, ilaq n taẓallit (salat) yebdd: tameṭṭut ur tettwasuter ara ad tẓalli deg wakud-a. Abeddel-a d aḥric seg ddin timmad-is, yettwasen s zik.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.15: Abeddel-a ur yebɛid ara seg liman neɣ seg usemres n ddin. D abeddel yettwasnen, ilaq ad yettwaḥess war tuɣdit: d aḥric seg uɣanib aṭṭabiɛi n tudert tarewhanit n tmeṭṭut.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.17: Akud-a yezmer ad yettwaqbel s lehna: ur d-yeqqar ara azal n liman neɣ amagnu n usemres n ddin.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.18: Ma tebda tiregwa mi ara tettẓallit, ad tebdd: ur tessefk ara ad tt-tkemmleḍ neɣ ad tt-terreḍ. Deg unamek-nniḍen, mi ara tfak tiregwa, taẓallit tettuɣal d tamagnut seld ghusl (asired ameqqran), ayen yellan d tuɣalin ɣer ṭṭhara.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.19: War tuẓumt n Ṛamḍan, anda ussan ur d-tuẓumeḍ ara deg tiregwa ttuɣalen mbeɛd (qadaa), tizallit ur d-tuẓumeḍ ara ssebba-a s wudem amatu ur ttuɣalent ara mbeɛd. Amgirred-a yettwabder seg tamahut n sin n tebɛidin-a: taẓallit d tigawt n yal ass yettuɣalen aṭas n tikkal deg wass, ma d tuẓumt d tin n useggas u teqqen ɣer yiwen n yewrar.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.20: Amgirred-a yezmer ad d-yefk ccwal mi ara tafeḍ fiqh tikkelt tamezwarut. Ur yenni ara taẓallit tesɛa azal ugar: ad tḍefreḍ abeddel akken yettwafka d aḥric seg usemres n ddin.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.21: Ur tẓallit ara deg tiregwa ur yebbi ara ad tebɛedḍ seg tarewhanit-ik. Aṭas n yibadat d usnirem n ddin ttqimen yellan deg wakud-a.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.31: Kra n yimalen, am tɣuri neɣ aṭṭaf s ufus n Lqur’an, zemren ad ilin d ayen i d-yettemxalafen yiwen ɣef wayeḍ ɣef tmedrest n fiqh. Alaɣ ɣer rray i teḍfareḍ s wudem amatu, neɣ asuter n rray n umusnaw yettwasnen, yettɛawan ad tt-id-tbeggneḍ.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.33: Abeddel n taẓallit deg tiregwa d abeddel yettwasnen, ilaq ad yettwaḥess war tuɣdit. Aṭas n yiwellihen n tarewhanit ttqimen yellan deg wakud-a, u rray n umusnaw yettwasnen yeqqim d win n usteqsi usligen.

PregnancyExercise.6: Ad tqimeḍ tettiliḍ d tamnaṭ s wudem aḥlawan u s wudem yekfan deg yal tlata n wayyuren.
PregnancyExercise.13: Tikli, aɛum d yoga n lḥemla zemren ad ttwasumren deg lḥemla meṛṛa, s ukud i k-yehwan i wayen i tḥessed.
PregnancyExercise.17: Ur txedmeḍ ara tagnit s wazal ameqqran neɣ imala s tiyir n unfel, nezzeh seg wasteɣ wis sin:
PregnancyExercise.18: Tagnit s wazal ameqqran (tazzla tuqwiyt, tagnit s uqiḍun s tazzla)
PregnancyExercise.19: Imala s tiyir n unfel (tiski, tuɣalin ɣef uɛudiw, tamellalt ɣef lqaɛa d azeggaɣ)
PregnancyExercise.20: Tagnit n tmenɣi neɣ n umennuɣ
PregnancyExercise.21: Aɛekkem ameqqran deg uzalal neɣ deg tfiḍ tameqqrant
PregnancyExercise.22: Ahulfu n uɣil ur nelli ara d amagnu neɣ uzeṛqel
PregnancyExercise.23: Lweǧɛ, idammen neɣ asemmed deg uɛekkem
PregnancyExercise.24: Leɛyaṭ ur d-yettɛeddi ara seld unsa
PregnancyExercise.25: Sell dima i yineslan n ugris-ik u ttmeslay d taqabalt neɣ d uṭṭbib send ad tebduḍ neɣ ad tbeddeleḍ tagnit.
PregnancyExercise.27: Tagnit tahlawant yettuɣalen d tuffirt i uṭas n lḥemla: ayen yelhan d ad tessemxalfeḍ azal ɣer yal asteɣ u ɣer wayen i tḥessed.

PregnancyWeekly.6: Imalasen igejdanen seg wayyur amezwaru ar wayyur wis tlata, i wakken ad teẓreḍ acu ara d-yeḍru deg yal asteɣ.
PregnancyWeekly.7: Yal lḥemla tetteddu s wagmuḍ-is: tilɣa-a d timatuyin u zemrent ad ttemxalafent seg yiwet tmeṭṭut ɣer tayeḍ.
PregnancyWeekly.10: Asteɣ wis sin: ugar n lehna
PregnancyWeekly.13: Tilɣa i d-yettuɣalen deg yal asteɣ
PregnancyWeekly.14: Melmi ara tsuteḍ aɣbel s tazzla
PregnancyWeekly.16: Asteɣ amezwaru isbedd isekkilen: iɣsan meṛṛa igejdanen n uqcic ttwaxelqen s wudem aqrawan. D wakud daɣen anda leɛyaṭ d ugar n tuɣalin n uẓeṭṭa ttuɣalen, s wazal yemxalfen aṭas seg yiwet tmeṭṭut ɣer tayeḍ.
PregnancyWeekly.18: Tilɣa-a, ɣas ma ur nelli ara tuffirt kra n tikkal, d tabɣest n ugris ittwaɛeqlen s wudem amnir i lḥemla.
PregnancyWeekly.19: Asteɣ wis sin s waṭas d win yelhan s waṭas, mi ara d-banent tikli timezwura n uqcic.
PregnancyWeekly.21: S wudem amatu ttwaḥsent gar yimalasen 18 d 22, kra uzzig ma yella mačči d lḥemla-inek tamezwarut.
PregnancyWeekly.22: Asteɣ wis tlata yessewjad ugris i tulawt, s tuɣalin n uzal d leɛyaṭ ittwaẓran ugar. Isemmeden n usemmid (i d-yettusemman Braxton Hicks) zemren daɣen ad d-banen.
PregnancyWeekly.23: Isemmeden-a s wudem amatu ur ttilin ara d imeṛṛaḥen u ur ttaɣen ara aṭas; ttemxalafen d wid n tulawt.
PregnancyWeekly.26: Asteɣ wis tlata: ad tsewjdeḍ i tulawt
PregnancyWeekly.27: Aḍfar n uṭṭbib deg yal asteɣ
PregnancyWeekly.28: Anẓar d leɛyaṭ, nezzeh deg usteɣ amezwaru
PregnancyWeekly.29: Ssebbat n lweǧɛ deg uẓeṭṭa yeqqnen ɣer uɣal n yimi n uẓeṭṭa
PregnancyWeekly.30: Uḥulfu ahlawan n unfas ɣer taggara n lḥemla
PregnancyWeekly.31: Ugur n unẓar deg taggara n usteɣ wis tlata
PregnancyWeekly.32: Kra n tilɣa ttuḥwağen rray n uṭṭbib s tazzla, ula d acu n usteɣ:
PregnancyWeekly.36: Lweǧɛ n uqerruy ameqqran neɣ ugur n yiẓri
PregnancyWeekly.37: Taẓirt ur nelli ara d tamagnut
PregnancyWeekly.39: Yal asteɣ yesɛa yisnifilen-is: ma tessneḍ-iten send, ad k-iɛiwen ad tettidireḍ yal asteɣ ugar, war ma yettwaḥbes uḍfar n yal tikkelt ɣer taqabalt neɣ aṭṭbib.

RamadanFasting.6: Iwellihen n yal ass d tiwelhiwin n usnaw i wakken ad tettidireḍ yimalasen n Ṛamaḍan deg tiregwa s lehna.
RamadanFasting.8: Agbur-a d asnaw kan. Isteqsiyen n ddin ilaqen ad ttwaseknen i yineɣman yettwasnen. AWA ur d-yettaf ara fatwas neɣ ahilen n ddin usligen.
RamadanFasting.12: Aḍfar n yussan i wakken ad d-tuɣaleḍ tuẓumt
RamadanFasting.14: Deg tiregwa-ik, tuẓumt ur tettwasuter ara: akud-a yeǧǧa tameṭṭut deg waddad anda aṭas n yibadat, ula d tuẓumt, ttbedden s wudem uzɣel. Abeddel-a yettwaqbel d lxfif, mačči d akkes neɣ ɛiqab.
RamadanFasting.15: Abeddel n tuẓumt deg tiregwa ur yebɛid ara seg usemres n ddin. Yebdd kan i lweqt yelhan, sakin yettuɣal s wudem amagnu mi ara tfak tiregwa-ik, war ma truḥ kra n tigawt n liman. Ussan ur d-tuẓumeḍ ara ad d-ttuɣalen mbeɛd (qadaa), ɣer berra n Ṛamaḍan.
RamadanFasting.17: Abeddel-a izmer daɣen ad yettwaḥess am lweqt yemxalfen deg wayyur, anda tarewhanit tkemmel ad d-tbeggen s ubrid-nniḍen, war tuẓumt.
RamadanFasting.19: Waddad-a ur ilaq ara ad yettwaḥess s tuɣdit: d aḥric seg ddawra tabiɛit n ugris u ddin timmad-is tettwali-t.
RamadanFasting.20: Ur tuẓumeḍ ara ur yebbi ara ad tebɛedḍ seg wayyur n Ṛamaḍan. Aṭas n yibadat n tarewhanit ttqimen yellan u ttbeddilen ad tettidireḍ lweqt-a akken iwata.
RamadanFasting.30: Tigawin-a timecṭuḥin, ɣas ma ttilint d tifessasin, ttɛawant ad tqimeḍ teqqnaḍ ɣer rruḥ n wayyur, ula d acu n waddad-ik.
RamadanFasting.31: Aḍfar n wussan n tiregwa-ik deg Ṛamaḍan yeǧǧa asiḍen n wussan ara d-tuɣaleḍ (qadaa) ad yili fessus, u ur tettwaḥtaǧeḍ ara ad tettekleḍ ɣef tmuγli mi ara yfak wayyur.
RamadanFasting.32: Aru azemz n yal ass ur d-tuẓumeḍ ara akken i ttedduḍ
RamadanFasting.33: Seqdec akalandri, asnas neɣ aɣmis udmawan
RamadanFasting.34: Xdem asenqed uzzig deg taggara n wayyur i wakken ad tesnetleḍ amḍan ameggaz
RamadanFasting.36: AWA yezmer ad k-iɛiwen ad tḍefreḍ ddawra-inek deg Ṛamaḍan meṛṛa, akken ad d-tafeḍ talɣut-a s wudem fessus mbeɛd.
RamadanFasting.38: Iswiren tigejdanin n tuɣalin n wussan ur d-tuẓumeḍ ara (akud, imala uslig am lḥemla neɣ uẓẓal) zemren ad ttemxalafen ɣef tmedrest n fiqh. I yal waddad uslig neɣ uweɛṛan, rray n umusnaw yettwasnen yeqqim d win n usteqsi.
RamadanFasting.40: Abeddel n tuẓumt deg tiregwa d lxfif yettwasnen, mačči d abeddel n usemres n ddin. Ad tettidireḍ lweqt-a s wudem-nniḍen, ad tḍefreḍ wussan-ik u ad tsuteḍ tallalt mi ara tcukkeḍ, meṛṛa ttɛawanen ad tɛeddiḍ Ṛamaḍan s lehna.

RegularIrregularCycle.1:
Ddawra tamagnut neɣ ur nelli ara d tamagnut:
d acu i d amgirred?
RegularIrregularCycle.4: Yal ddawra n tiregwa tbedd s timmad-is. Ma tfehmeḍ acu ttwaḥsaben d “amagnu” yettɛawan ad tḍefreḍ ṣṣeḥḥa-inek ugar u ad tafeḍ ayen izmer ad yili d ugur.
RegularIrregularCycle.6: Ddawra n tiregwa tamagnut: d acu-t?
RegularIrregularCycle.7: Ddawra ur nelli ara d tamagnut: acu i d-tsemmal?
RegularIrregularCycle.8: Ssebbat izemren n ddawra ur nelli ara d tamagnut
RegularIrregularCycle.11: Ddawra ttwaḥsab d tamagnut ma yella teɣzi-s temxalef gar 21 d 35 n wussan, s umgirred ur tezdi ara 7 n wussan seg yiwet ddawra ɣer tayeḍ.
RegularIrregularCycle.13: Ayen yelhan d ad tɛassed agmuḍ-ik deg wayyuren.
RegularIrregularCycle.15: Yal tameṭṭut temxalaf. Ayen yelhan d ad tessneḍ agmuḍ-ik d yisnifilen-is imagnuyen.
RegularIrregularCycle.16: Ddawra ttwaḥsab ur nelli ara d tamagnut ma yella teɣzi-s temxalef s waṭas neɣ ur nelli ara d ayen yettwaẓran (amgirred n ugar n 7 n wussan). Waya izmer ad yettban deg ddurat imecṭuḥen aṭas, ddurat ɣezzifen aṭas, neɣ ulac ovulation.
RegularIrregularCycle.18: Imgirred-a zemren ad ilin n lweqt kan neɣ ad kemmlen deg waṭas n ddurat.
RegularIrregularCycle.20: Ddawra ur nelli ara d tamagnut n lweqt kan tezmer ad tili d tamagnut (aɣilif, isnifilen n yihurmunen, leɛyaṭ…). Maca ma tkemmel, yelha ad tnadiḍ ssebba.
RegularIrregularCycle.22: Ur nelli ara d amagnu n yihurmunen
RegularIrregularCycle.24: Azal ameẓẓyan aṭas neɣ ameqqran aṭas
RegularIrregularCycle.26: Ulac tiregwa deg ugar n 3 n wayyuren (ɣer berra n lḥemla/uẓẓal)
RegularIrregularCycle.27: Ddurat ɣezzifen aṭas (ugar n 90 n wussan) neɣ ddurat imecṭuḥen aṭas (ddaw 21 n wussan)
RegularIrregularCycle.28: Lweǧɛ ameqqran i k-yeǧǧan ur tettidireḍ ara s wudem amagnu
RegularIrregularCycle.29: Idammen ameqqran aṭas neɣ ur nelli ara d imagnuyen

Tudrist tarewhanit
seld uɣilif n lḥemla
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.6: Kra n tmeẓrin n tudrist tarewhanit i wakken ad tɛeddiḍ lweqt n uɣilif s lehna, s ubrid, d lǧerr.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.8: Agbur-a d asnaw. Isteqsiyen n ddin usligen ilaqen ad ttwaseknen i umusnaw yettwasnen. AWA ur d-yettaf ara fatwas udmawan.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.13: Kra n tmeẓrin i wakken ad tkemmleḍ
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.15: Aɣilif n lḥemla izmer ad yili d amudur aweɛran aṭas. Ccwal, ssusem, tuccḍa neɣ ussuter n tuɣalin ɣer deffir d tuffɣiwin tinagan n yimdanen.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.16: Ahulfu n iwulmen-a ur yebbi ara ad tebɛedḍ seg liman. Yal tameṭṭut tezmer ad tɛeddi lḥezn-is s lemɛawda-is.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.18: Ccwal • ussuter n tensa • ssusem • tallalt
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.19: 2. Waddad izmer ad yemxalef ɣef unamek
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.20: Seld aɣilif, ilugan n ddin zemren ad ttkelen ɣef waddad d ɣef wanaw n idammen.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.21: Nezzeh, d ayen yelhan ad tfarqeḍ gar yinawen n idammen send ad tferneḍ acu n usemres n ddin ara tḍefreḍ.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.27: Waddad udmawan izmer ad yesɛu tiririt tayeḍ. Ayen yelhan d ad tsuteḍ rray n win yettwasnen.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.29: Sber ur yebbi ara ur tettɣeṛṛeḍ ara neɣ ur tḥessed ara lweǧɛ. Izmer kan ad d-yilin d lemɛawda n ubrid s liman d usirem.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.30: Tigawin timecṭuḥin zemrent ad ɛawnent ad d-tuɣaleḍ lehna: asuter, kra n lweqt n dhikr, tuḍfa n ugbur n ddin neɣ tinsa n win i tḥemmleḍ.

ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.38: Eǧǧ lweqt i usuref n uɣilif-ik
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.40: Kemmel imala imecṭuḥen n tarewhanit ma ttawin-d lehna
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.41: Suter rray i yal asteqsi n ddin uslig

ReligiousFaq.1:
Isteqsiyen i d-yettuɣalen
ɣef fiqh n tilawin
ReligiousFaq.6: Isteqsiyen i d-yettuɣalen ugar ɣef fiqh n tilawin, yeddan deg yiwen n wadeg s tririyin yewwin.
ReligiousFaq.8: Agbur-a d asnaw kan. Isteqsiyen n ddin ilaqen ad ttwaseknen i yineɣman yettwasnen. AWA ur d-yettaf ara fatwas neɣ ahilen n ddin usligen.
ReligiousFaq.11: Tmedrasin n fiqh izemren ad ttemxalafen
ReligiousFaq.14: Aṭas n yisteqsiyen ɣef ddawra, taẓallit d tuẓumt ttuɣalen s lemɛawda seg yiwet tmeṭṭut ɣer tayeḍ. Ha-t-an tririyin timatuyin i wid i d-yettuɣalen ugar; i wakken ad tkemmleḍ, yal asentel yettwabder daɣen s uzrar deg umagrad-is.
ReligiousFaq.15: D acu i d fiqh n tilawin?
ReligiousFaq.16: Fiqh n tilawin yesdukkel ilugan n tigawt i yeqqnen s wudem uslig ɣer ugris d ibadat n tilawin: ddawra, ṭṭhara, taẓallit, tuẓumt, nifas d istiḥada.
ReligiousFaq.17: Acu n yisental igejdanen i yeṭṭef fiqh n tilawin?
ReligiousFaq.18: Yeṭṭef nezzeh tiregwa d ddawra, ṭṭhara, ghusl, taẓallit d tuẓumt deg d seld tiregwa, nifas d istiḥada.
ReligiousFaq.19: D acu i d amgirred gar tiregwa, idammen n seld tulawt d idammen ur nelli ara d imagnuyen?
ReligiousFaq.20: Tiregwa (ḥayḍ) teḍfer ddawra tamagnut, nifas yeḍru seld tulawt, ma d istiḥada d idammen ur nelli ara d imagnuyen, ɣer berra n ddawra. Yal yiwen yesɛa waddad-is.
ReligiousFaq.21: D acu i ixeddem taẓallit deg tiregwa?
ReligiousFaq.22: Taẓallit tbedd deg wakud-a: d abeddel yettwasnen, ilaq ad yettwaḥess war tuɣdit.
ReligiousFaq.23: D acu i ixeddem tuẓumt deg tiregwa?
ReligiousFaq.24: Tuẓumt daɣen tbedd; ussan ur d-tuẓumeḍ ara ttuɣalen mbeɛd (qadaa), ɣer berra n Ṛamaḍan.
ReligiousFaq.25: Acuɣer tizallit ur d-tuẓumeḍ ara s wudem amatu ur ttuɣalent ara, ur am tuẓumt?
ReligiousFaq.26: Amgirred-a yekka-d seg tamahut n sin n tigawin: taẓallit d tin n yal ass yettuɣalen, ma d tuẓumt d tin n useggas u teqqen ɣer yiwen n wayyur. Aḍfar n ubeddel d aḥric s wudem aɛlayan seg usemres n ddin.
ReligiousFaq.27: Melmi ara d-tuɣal taẓallit seld tiregwa?
ReligiousFaq.28: Mi ara tfak tiregwa u ara txedmeḍ ghusl, taẓallit tettuɣal d tamagnut, war lɛeṭṭil.
ReligiousFaq.29: D acu i d tamlilt n ghusl?
ReligiousFaq.30: Ghusl d asired ameqqran i yeǧǧan ad d-tuɣaleḍ ɣer ṭṭhara i yettwaḥwağen i uɣal ɣer taẓallit d yibadat-nniḍen.
ReligiousFaq.31: D acu ilaq ad txedmeḍ ma yella ur tettɛeqleḍ ara ma yefka tiregwa?
ReligiousFaq.32: Aẓer n ulac n idammen s lweqt yekfan, mačči s wudem n uḥulfu n lweqt kan, yettɛawan ad d-yeban waddad.
ReligiousFaq.33: Yezmer ad yettwaxdem ibadat-nniḍen deg tiregwa?
ReligiousFaq.34: Ih: dhikr, isutar, ṣṣadaqa, tamusni n ddin d tigawin-nniḍen n lxir ttqimen yellan.
ReligiousFaq.35: Acuɣer kra n tririyin zemrent ad ttemxalafent ɣef waddad?
ReligiousFaq.36: Fiqh d taɣult n tfesser: rray izmer ad yemxalef ɣef tmedrest n fiqh d ɣef lḥal udmawan, war ma yili yiwen n rray d win n tidet weḥdes.
ReligiousFaq.37: Fiqh amaslam yeṭṭef imgirred yettwasnen n tfesser ɣef kra n yimalen imecṭuḥen. Imgirred-a llan zik u ttwaḥsaben d imaqaneyen deg ddin.
ReligiousFaq.38: Ɣef ssebba n wayen ittwaɛyan, asteqsi yiwen izmer ad yesɛu tririyin yemxalfen cwiṭ. Waya ur yebbi ara belli tiririt tezmer ad tili d tuccḍa s wudem awurman: yemmal tarrayt tamxalaft d tɣuri n yiwen n yimenzayen.
ReligiousFaq.40: Aḍfar s wudem n dima n yiwen n umnaw yettwasnen, war ma tbeddleḍ rray yal tikkelt ɣef wayen i tafeḍ, yettɛawan ad yeqqim usemres-ik n ddin d afrawan u d ahlawan.
ReligiousFaq.41: Kra n yimala ttqimen weɛṛen ad ttwafsen s uglam amatu yiwen. D ayen yellan nezzeh mi ara:
ReligiousFaq.42: Yella ccek ɣef wakud anda tfukk tiregwa s tidet
ReligiousFaq.43: Anaw n idammen yeqqim ur yettwasen ara (tiregwa, istiḥada, wayeḍ)
ReligiousFaq.44: Ccek yeqqim ɣef usentel n ghusl
ReligiousFaq.45: Asteqsi n tuɣalin n taẓallit yeqqim ur yettwasen ara
ReligiousFaq.48: Mi ara yili waddad d udmawan, d aweɛran neɣ ittkemmilen, ur yezmir ara ad yettwafsi s talɣut tamatut. Tuɣalin ɣer umusnaw yettwasnen, izemren ad yeṭṭef waddad-ik uslig, d abrid yelhan akk deg wanda-a. AWA ur d-yettaf ara fatwas neɣ ahilen n ddin usligen.
ReligiousFaq.49: Fiqh n tilawin yeṭṭef aṭas n yimalen n usemres n ddin n tilawin
ReligiousFaq.50: Kra n yimalen zemren ad ttemxalafen s tidet ɣef tmedrest n fiqh
ReligiousFaq.51: Talɣut tamatut ur d-tettnaqqes ara tudrist tarewhanit tudmawant
ReligiousFaq.52: Ccek ittkemmilen yelha ad yettwaseqdec i umusnaw yettwasnen
ReligiousFaq.53: Tamlilt n AWA d tasnawt, mačči ad d-yefk fatwas
ReligiousFaq.54: Isteqsiyen i d-yettuɣalen ɣef fiqh n tilawin — AWA
